about_short_description.short_description: Daily is the enterprise WebRTC platform to build real-time voice, video and AI for a secure and compliant global infrastructure.

product.name: Pipecat
product.description: An open source orchestration framework for real-time voice and multimodal AI agents, enabling developers to build conversational AI applications.

product.name: Pipecat Cloud
product.description: A cloud service to deploy voice AI agents built with Pipecat on Daily's global WebRTC infrastructure.

product.name: Daily WebRTC Infrastructure
product.description: Global WebRTC infrastructure providing real-time voice and video communication with low latency and enterprise-grade reliability.

product.name: Daily Video Component System (VCS)
product.description: A cloud-native toolkit for building animated graphics, custom layouts, and event-driven components into live and recorded video streams.

product.name: Daily APIs and SDKs
product.description: APIs and SDKs for integrating real-time voice, video, and AI capabilities into applications across web and mobile platforms.

product.name: Always-On Video Call API
product.description: An API to embed persistent, always-on video calls into websites or portals for continuous real-time communication.
